---
title: "Publications & Media"
---

The Open Data Lab and its tools have been featured in external publications and community platforms focused on open data, data science, and education.

These features highlight the Lab’s approach to reproducible research, open data accessibility, and public-facing scholarship.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Featured Talks

- **NYC Open Data Week 2026** — *Teaching with NYC Open Data: Publishing Student Civic Research Through Reproducible Workflows*\
  [🎥 Watch the talk](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Vw8PhY7NDGE) · [📊 View slides](https://martinezc1.github.io/nyc-open-data-week-2026/#/title-slide)

- **posit::conf(2026)** — *Designing Reproducible Learning Ecosystems with R and Quarto*\
  [🔗 Conference sessions](https://conf.posit.co/2026/sessions/)

- **useR! 2026** — *Teaching Reproducibility by Design: An End-to-End R Workflow Using Quarto, Open Data, and Package Development*\
  [🔗 Conference site](https://user2026.r-project.org/)

- **New York Open Statistical Programming Meetup** — *Lowering Barriers to Open Data: Classroom to CRAN*\
  [🎥 Watch the talk](https://www.youtube.com/live/RbB4wu4zm2Q)

- **Brooklyn College 29th Annual Faculty Day Conference 2026** — *Reproducible Research Using R: The Impact of Open Data and Open Resources*\
  [🔗 Conference program](https://www.brooklyn.edu/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/Faculty-Day-2026-Full-Program.pdf)

- **Brooklyn College Psychology Department In-House Conference 2026** — *The Accidental Author: Scaffolding Reproducible Research and Digital Scholarly Identity in an M.S. Psychology Classroom*
